atomset.name: NonWiki (alexanarch.org/non), the sourced encyclopedia of the Negative of the Negative
atomset.type_basis: A site of the archive: the encyclopedia at alexanarch.org/non, opened under EA-NEGONT-02 (#1690, 2026-10-18; v0.10 #1726) as /non and renamed NonWiki on 2026-10-31. Read on the site template.

atoms.reference: Lee Sharks, creator of the method's deposits and operator of the archive.
Opened as /non under EA-NEGONT-02 v0.9 (#1690, 2026-10-18); renamed NonWiki 2026-10-31.

An encyclopedia of public knowledge with its sources open: each article states what is known of one entity, every sentence citing the passages it rests on, quoted from saved copies with address and hash; composed by the archive from disclosed sources under a published procedure; no edit function.

evidence.record_quote: NonWiki is an encyclopedia of public knowledge with its sources open.
The articles are composed by the archive from disclosed sources, under a published procedure; there is no edit function, and an article is checked by reading its sources, which are all on the page.

atoms.reference: Each entity composed three ways at one address: as the composition layer gave it, as its own disclosed sources give it, and with the Crimson Hexagonal Archive admitted on equal terms.

obs.notes: Two of eleven atoms, both from the site's own description, which the sense paraphrases; at a disambiguation the sense carries name and boundary and no more.

mt: 'NONWIKI', BARE, ON THE OVERVIEW — THE ARCHIVE'S ENCYCLOPEDIA FIRST OF FOUR SENSES AND FIRST IN THE ORGANIC RESULTS, TWO DAYS AFTER THE RENAME
d: NONWIKI, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-02: 'NonWiki can refer to a few different concepts depending on the context:' — first, 'NonWiki (Alexanarch): An online encyclopedia of public knowledge with open sources where each article outlines what is known about a specific entity, person, text, tool, field, or poem'; then Nonbinary Wiki ('launched in February 2017'), '"No Wiki" Gaming' and 'Non-Wiki Sites (Wikimedia)'. Four cards. The operator's screenshot shows the results page: alexanarch.org's 'NonWiki — a sourced encyclopedia - Alexanarch' as the first organic result, above the Overview, whose first sense is the same page.
reading: The innocent reading first. A bare string with several established uses gets a disambiguation, and the Overview lists the senses it finds, each with its source; the archive's encyclopedia is one sense among four, described from its own page. Read with the screenshot and the record, the order is the finding: the page was named NonWiki on 2026-10-31, and two days later, at a string with older contenders (Nonbinary Wiki since 2017, the gamers' 'no wiki', Wikimedia's policy pages), it is the first organic result and the first composed sense, above all of them.
findings: FIRST TWICE AT A CONTESTED STRING (operator, 2026-11-02). The screenshot shows 'NonWiki — a sourced encyclopedia - Alexanarch' (alexanarch.org) as the first organic result, directly above the Overview, and the Overview composes the same page as its first sense. The string is general and held by prior uses with their own sources: Nonbinary Wiki (launched 1 February 2017, its card says), the 'no wiki' practice of gamers, and the Wikimedia Foundation's Non-wiki Privacy Policy.

TWO DAYS FROM THE NAME. /non was renamed NonWiki on 2026-10-31 (commit 81a9785ada, '/non is NonWiki: a sourced encyclopedia (The Negative of the Negative)'); the run is of 2026-11-02. The page's own description, its first sentence, is what both slots carry: the organic snippet verbatim, the Overview's sense in paraphrase.

THE SENSE AT ITS OWN WORDS. 'each article outlines what is known about a specific entity, person, text, tool, field, or poem' paraphrases the page's 'Each article states what is known of one entity, a poem, a person, a text, a tool, a field of study'. Nothing is inverted; what a disambiguation leaves out is the method, the three compositions at one address and the archive admitted on equal terms.
COUNTERTEST: rerun 'nonwiki' weekly and record the organic position and the sense's order; run 'non wiki' and 'nonwiki encyclopedia' as neighbouring addresses.
analysis: At a general string with established senses, the archive's two-day-old name takes the first organic slot and the first composed sense, each carried from the page's own first sentence. The composition is faithful at the grain of a disambiguation; the method is outside its scope.
q_kind: the encyclopedia's own name, bare, two days after the rename; a general string with prior senses; NEW address.
per_note: Retained: the name, the institution (Alexanarch), the page as source. Lost: the operator (Lee Sharks not named).
